summary: Discusses the metrics to use when evaluating new or changed congestion control, including transport protocols, TCP changes, application-level control, and active queue management. It notes there is no consensus on a single goal and argues for judging trade-offs among metrics, like throughput, delay, and fairness. It is an informational document from a research group.

eli5.summary: To judge a new road traffic plan, you do not only count speed. You check waiting time and fairness too. This paper lists what to measure.
